messages:
maria_sales: Heads up — Nebula Health (YC S21) requesting a 6mo POC. They want trial credits ~100k tokens/month + dedicated support. Asking if we can extend startup promo.

sam_eng: Hosted is easiest. Do they need Private/VPC?

alex_cs: They mentioned PHI in the request earlier, so likely VPC. Lina, can you confirm security needs?

lina_security: If PHI, we need a signed BAA + Private deployment. Also we need to run the security questionnaire. Requirements: encryption at rest, KMS integration, audit logs.

jordan_revops: Quick outline of approvals: default startup promo = $5k over 3 months. RevOps can approve up to $10k. Anything > $10k or any private infra requires Deal Desk + legal signoff.

maria_sales: They asked for 6 months @100k tokens/mo — rough list value ~$12k. With startup discount they expect ~50% off. Also asking for dedicated onboarding.

jordan_revops: OK. We can push to $10k internally. Need VP signoff for more. Private infra adds base Dedicated fees (estimate $2k/month). Put numbers in a quote please.

maria_sales: Draft quote:
```
6mo POC
Promo credits: $10,000 applied across term
Private infra fee: $12,000 (6 x $2k)
Onboarding: 8 hours CS
Estimated total value: $22,000
```
Is that reasonable?

sam_eng: If private we need to reserve 2 GPUs and a VPC. Also need to know target throughput for KV cache sizing.

alex_cs: 8 hours onboarding for PHI seems low. Recommend 16 hours (runbooks, auth, app review).

maria_sales: Update noted — will change to 16h. Submitting to Deal Desk for extra promo if needed.

dealbot: dealbot: Deal submitted to Deal Desk for approval. Request: startup promo $10k credits + private infra fee $12k + 16h onboarding. Requestor: maria_sales. Thread: 1718504321.

jordan_revops: Pinging @vp_sales for signoff to increase promo to $15k given healthcare strategic value.

vp_sales: vp_sales: I'm OK to approve $15k promotional credits for this strategic healthcare POC, contingent on signed BAA and a 6-month commitment. Approving now.

lina_security: I'll kick off the questionnaire and BAA process. Maria, please share the technical contact and expected data flows. We need to confirm KMS and network topology.

maria_sales: Contact is dan@nebula.co. Data will be de-identified patient text plus imaging metadata. They will sign a BAA. Sending questionnaire now.

jordan_revops: Deal Desk approves final terms: $15k promo credits (distributed over 6 months), private infra fee $12k, 16h onboarding, signed BAA, 6mo POC. Special term ID: S-2026-064.

alex_cs: :thumbsup: I'll schedule CS time. Sam, can Eng provision the Dedicated pool next Tue?

sam_eng: Yes — will reserve GPUs and VPC. ETA for ready env: 3 business days after provisioning.

maria_sales: Thanks all — I'll update Nebula and send the BAA to sign.

dealbot: dealbot: Deal approved by Deal Desk (S-2026-064). Generating PO and promo code. :tada:
